blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The National Irrigation Administration (NIA) in the Ilocos region turned over three solar-powered irrigation projects in Piddig, Ilocos Norte, to improve water access for farmers and boost agricultural productivity. The Bimmanga, Sallaguid and San Antonio projects will provide irrigation to 45 hectares of farmland, using solar energy to help ensure a more reliable water supply. House Majority Leader and Ilocos Norte Rep. Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos joined the turnover ceremony on Thursday (Oct. 15), supporting efforts to increase farm productivity and improve farmers’ livelihoods.
